name: Host galaxy of PTF09ge (Hubble)
blurb: The host galaxy of PTF09ge, a barred lenticular galaxy where a star was torn apart by a black hole, seen by Hubble.
label: ptf09gehost-hubble
story: In this galaxy's core, a star passed too close to the central supermassive black hole and was ripped apart. Hubble's sharp eye traces extended arms reaching out from two knots in its disk.

claims.text: PTF09ge likely arose from the tidal disruption of a star by a supermassive black hole
A TDE is observed when a star passes close enough to a supermassive black hole
The host of PTF09ge is a barred lenticular galaxy
Its host shows extended arms reaching from two blue knots in the disk, in HST program 14717 imaging
Program 14717 targeted the PTF09ge host as a post-starburst TDE host
